stage: BASE Phase18 role-aware reset curriculum and zero-update injection gate
hypothesis: Phase17 can form a source-reference-only, outcome-stratified safe reset asset whose physical and actor-visible state inject exactly into StatefulRecoveryRLEnv.
intervention: Build an immutable role-aware manifest and inject fixed 16-env batches for success, critical, and pre-collapse height-fail at zero PPO/optimizer updates.
control: reset_fraction=0 returns before opening the manifest and consumes no reset RNG; all actual actions are restored as history/state only and are never imitation labels.

success.failure_interpretation: Source 93D is not exactly generated by the injected physical/clock state for this fixed batch; do not override actor observations or train.

height_fail.failure_interpretation: Source 93D is not exactly generated by the injected physical/clock state for this fixed batch; do not override actor observations or train.

result: The role-aware asset is valid and all three roles have safe eligible rows, but the exact state-injection gate fails for success and height-fail because their recorded 93D actor input is not fully reconstructible from the saved physical/clock state.
conclusion: Keep training locked. Directly forcing the saved 93D vector would create a reset/rollout observation mismatch and is not an acceptable repair.

five_update_preregistration_draft.source_checkpoint: freeze the same independent stand/recovery backend used by the paired control
five_update_preregistration_draft.candidate: role_aware_reset_fraction=0.05; outcome role sampled 1:1:1, then one eligible source row uniformly within role
five_update_preregistration_draft.actions: history/state only; no behavior cloning or imitation loss
five_update_preregistration_draft.paired_requirements: same checkpoint, optimizer, minibatches, RNG contract and official 5-episode matched gate
five_update_preregistration_draft.promotion: candidate no worse than source/control and stiff-fixed full success moves toward 5/5
five_update_preregistration_draft.abort: any actor/interface mismatch, any official regression, or any non-exact reset field

next: Repair or recapture the source contract so root/IMU angular velocity, projected gravity and gait/contact observation are deterministically tied to the stored physical/controller state; then rerun only the exact injection gate before reconsidering the draft.
boundaries: IsaacLab injection against official AimDK MuJoCo snapshots; not real hardware.
Controller snapshot is hash-exact in an env registry, but future official brake/latch consumption is not proven.
